answer: Every claim climbs the pigment of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The timber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
